name: restic-conditional-backend-writes
instr:
restic cannot prevent stale repository writers from replacing newer published indexes. Add atomic conditional writes to create only, replace an observed object version, or save unconditionally, returning the resulting version without changing ordinary saves.

The shared contract from `github.com/restic/restic/internal/backend` uses portable versions, receipts, capability reporting, and `ConflictError`. `IsConflict` recognizes wrapped conflicts but not absence, provider failure, or cancellation. `ErrConditionalWriteUnsupported` is exactly "conditional writes unsupported". Restrictive writes compare and mutate atomically or fail before mutation. Unconditional `Backend.Save` remains compatible.

`local.Create`, `mem.New`, `azure.Create`, `b2.Create`, `gs.Create`, and `rest.Create` implement consistent conditional behavior with native version representations. `mock.NewBackend` provides deterministic outcomes; `dryrun.New` predicts them without mutation. Backends composed through `retry.New`, cache `newBackend`, or global composition preserve conflict identity and receipts. Retries stop on conflicts, and caches invalidate only after success.

A `Repository` built by `repository.New` publishes indexes against their observed generation while preserving ordinary unpacked saves and config and key initialization.
